usedFor: Teachfloor holds your courses, and Asana receives follow-up work through “Create Task or Subtask” whenever a “Module Is Created”.

bestTemplate.name: “Module Is Created” in Teachfloor, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: A new course module becomes an Asana task, so reviewing it is assigned work.

watchOut: “Course Updated” is a separate trigger, so edits to existing modules will not create tasks here.
